02.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
3.

The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Jajpur P.S. Case No.413 of 2023 corresponding to C.T.(Spl. Pocso) Case No.129 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Special Court (POCSO), Jajpur for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 323/34/342/363/376(2)(n)/376(3)/506 of IPC.

entities.text: Court of learned Special Court (POCSO), Jajpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Learned State Counsel has obtained instructions including the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., which does not contain any allegation whatsoever of commission of offence under Section 376(3) of IPC.
As such, the anticipatory bail application is held to be maintainable.
5. Having regard to the nature of accusations against the petitioner, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail.

The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to surrender before the Court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, he shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the Court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
